text: {"lessons":["My account is still about 5% below its starting value despite recent gains, so I should keep risk and living-expense needs in view.","Repeatedly selling losing positions did not prevent further declines; I should decide using a consistent plan rather than reacting to losses alone.","The recent recovery followed several months of holding, reminding me that patience can help—but I should review whether my holdings remain suitably diversified and not assume prices will recover."]}
